summary: Web developers gain more of the Fetch API’s streaming-upload support: `Request` bodies can use `ReadableStream`, with a `duplex` option to support sending data as it is produced. Firefox also adds Permissions Policy interfaces for documents and iframes, exposes the CSS namespace in workers and worklets behind a preference, and improves WebRTC compatibility when FIPS security mode is enabled. Other updates cover canvas color spaces and clearer reporting when a response comes from the HTTP cache.
